newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan daily warns of chaos after gangster raids.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan daily warns of chaos after gangster raids.

text.p: East Africa's leading newspaper warned on Friday of impending chaos in Kenya after two raids this week by heavily armed gangsters who virtually took control of Nairobi's city centre.
The daily Nation, in a strong editorial comment, called on the police to act and prevent Nairobi from going down the path of the lawless Somali capital Mogadishu.
The commentary followed a raid on a main street of Nairobi on Thursday, the second this week, during which gangsters got away with $1,700 cash and 117 blank air tickets from Air Zaire.
They also looted and ransacked shops and business premises nearby as a helpless public watched in fear.

"Whether the crooks have bigger guns than the police or not, whether their weaponry is military rather than police calibre or not, they must not be allowed to again rape a section of the capital city as if it were another Mogadishu and Kenya had gone to the dogs and vultures," the editorial said.
It added: "Kenyans must be told who these cocky, swaggering criminals who are apparently taking over the capital city's streets with guns mounted atop Mogadishu-style pick-up 'technicals' are."
On Wednesday heavily armed gangsters took over Nairobi's Kirinyaga street in a 20-minute robbery operation during which armed policemen fled for their lives.
